items.name: 延庆观
items.subject: 玉皇阁现存主体
items.yearNote: 元代现存玉皇阁；年表为约略定位
items.structure: Square masonry base with three arched openings in front, octagonal upper drum and single octagonal canopy; retain the glazed sloping transition roof and terrace. Portrait 1024x1536.
items.colors: Muted brick red wall, grey-green glazed roof and muted yellow-green ornament, pale stone balustrade.

items.name: 汤阴岳飞庙
items.subject: 二殿正面
items.yearNote: 明清建筑与后世修缮；二殿确切营建年未详
items.structure: Five-bay single-eaved hip-and-gable hall, central entrance and lattice window panels; keep the roof silhouette and low terrace. Landscape 1536x1024.
items.colors: Grey-green tiles, faded vermilion doors and columns, light grey stone paving.

items.name: 嵩阳书院
items.subject: 清代大门正面
items.yearNote: 现存大门属清代并经修缮；康熙时期约略定位
items.structure: Three-bay gate with ONE round rolled roof without straight ridge, central rectangular open doorway, stone side columns, brick side walls and central stone stairs. Landscape 1536x1024.
items.colors: Grey roof tiles, grey brick walls, faded dark red lintel and door, pale grey stone columns.

items.name: 大相国寺
items.subject: 大雄宝殿正面
items.yearNote: 清乾隆重建阶段，不是北齐建寺年
items.structure: Seven front bays, TWO eave tiers, double-eaved hip-and-gable roof, stone balustraded terrace and central stairs. Remove foreground people and parasols. Landscape 1536x1024.
items.colors: Muted grey-green and yellow glazed tiles, dark red wooden columns and lattice doors, blue-green bracket paint and pale stone terrace.

items.name: 郑州城隍庙
items.subject: 三间大殿正面
items.unitName: 郑州城隍庙（含文庙大成殿）
items.yearNote: 现存明清古建筑；单体确切营建年未详
items.structure: Three-bay SINGLE-eaved hip-and-gable hall, four pale stone front columns, central entrance and two red timber side panels. Landscape 1536x1024.
items.colors: Green glazed tiles, pale grey stone columns, vermilion panels, blue-green bracket paintings.

items.name: 郏县文庙
items.subject: 大成殿正面
items.yearNote: 现存大成殿与明清修缮；不采用五代创庙年
items.structure: Five-bay single-eaved hip-and-gable hall, four carved dragon stone front columns and side masonry piers; central stair ramp with carved dragon panel. Remove obscuring trees. Landscape 1536x1024.
items.colors: Weathered grey-green and orange glazed roof, grey carved stone columns, dark aged timber and red doors.

items.name: 郏县山陕会馆
items.subject: 门楼与钟鼓楼组合
items.yearNote: 清代建筑，现存组合单体确年未详
items.structure: Preserve THREE linked structures: central gate/stage block flanked by TWO tall bell/drum pavilions, each with two eave tiers and open upper storey; lower central curled gateway roof; photograph exact ensemble. Landscape 1536x1024.
items.colors: Grey tiled roofs, weathered grey brick and pale masonry, dark brown wood, muted remnant painted ornament.

items.name: 临沣寨
items.subject: 西门及相连红石寨墙
items.yearNote: 同治元年红石寨墙重建
items.structure: One rounded arch gate inset in red sandstone wall, small blank rectangular plaque over arch, sloping curved masonry parapet on both sides as photo. No roofed pavilion or invented battlements. Landscape 1536x1024.
items.colors: Reddish ochre sandstone blocks with pale mortar joints, grey-brown worn stone arch and earth threshold.

items.name: 高阁寺
items.subject: 阁楼及高台上部
items.yearNote: 明代建筑及后世修缮；年表为约略定位
items.structure: Draw the existing double-eaved pavilion atop high masonry platform, keeping visible red upper wall and pale stone balustrade. Oblique low-angle photo geometry, retain only photographed upper platform; do not invent unseen stairs or lower platform. Landscape 1536x1024.
items.colors: Grey roof tiles, dark aged bracket timber with blue-green traces, red upper walls and warm grey brick platform.

items.name: 浚县文治阁
items.subject: 十字街钟鼓楼现存主体
items.yearNote: 现存楼阁据研究为康熙时期复建，年表约略定位；国保名单所列明代为城墙及文治阁整体时代
items.structure: One square brick gate platform with a single central arched passage, TWO eave tiers above, three-bay open lower gallery and closed red upper room; front view from photograph, blank all plaques, remove shops, wires, barriers and traffic. Portrait 1024x1536.
items.colors: Weathered reddish brick platform with grey stone arch, muted red upper walls and timber, grey-green roof tiles, dark aged bracket wood.
